model.reason_no_cluster_hints: The accepted lifecycle is root-fixed. A target-independent dynamic family proposer/registry-extension protocol is not yet audited. No authored24 word or precomposed target cluster is supplied.

ordering_specification.all_keys: At the exact current global branch point, order every legal key; retain every alternative. Forced action always uses its sole base key.
ordering_specification.proved_outputs: Exact output formula codes of already selected primitive row placements, not formulas merely marked on unoccupied rows.
tiers: Novel MP output with both ordered referenced rows selected
Novel instantiate output whose exact universal AST is already a selected output
Novel eq_subst output whose exact equality antecedent and inner implication antecedent are already selected outputs
Novel eq_subst output whose equality antecedent is already selected
ordering_specification.ties: Exact output AST node count, canonical primitive witness JSON, recipe index, ordered reference tuple. No geometry-specific constants/variable substitutions/target proof path in code.
ordering_specification.scope: Author-designed ordering control, not RL training, a pruning rule or a host logical oracle. Full point legality and proof validity still come from complete graph and independent checker.

source_boundaries.grammar: Same 229 recipes: 144 literal ordered two-port MP, 1 named guarded I.2 axiom, 3 exact recipient assumptions, 54 instantiation implications, 27 equality-substitution implications. No new rules or formulas.
source_boundaries.context: Original exact ordered three ground hypotheses and retained guarded I.2; local definition hypotheses never enter global seeds.
source_boundaries.boundary: 24 active positive obligations and exactly three seeded placements at generation zero; fixed original target and full negative-row formula exterior sentinel; translation only.
source_boundaries.source_body_registry: Validate all 171 registered finite bodies with complete source/native/dependency bindings; no active descriptors or body proposal keys.
source_boundaries.degree: Complete implicit domains from every recipe and every ordered strict-prior reference binding, all remote marking filters, explicit zero/absent distinctions and exact distinct identity multiplicity.
source_boundaries.scheduler: Unchanged primitive decision/step enforces global dead, global forced then earliest generation; full chosen domain enumerated before ordering.
source_boundaries.fallback: Base and fixed ordering are complete permutations; no shortlist or learned exclusion. Every proved exhausted child is excluded only in restored parent.
source_boundaries.rollback: Paired graph/hint checkpoints with exact whole initial semantic state restored for unknown or complete finite exhaustion.
source_boundaries.trace: Every node/decision/order/step/exclusion/rollback stores full semantic SHA and exact point/row/refcount/exclusion/hint projection; independent decoder reconstructs omitted factor tables from complete frozen language.
source_boundaries.trace_cutoff: 2,000-event cutoff may truncate the final operation trace; label unknown_trace_budget, restore exact paired root, never certify such a truncated subtree or add an unknown-child exclusion.
source_boundaries.decoder: Every 24 logical row command, ordered MP reference and full decorated identity remains present. Ground assumptions become exact fresh named axioms for the same Gamma-relative sequent; no discharge, universal closure, proof compression or rewritten theorem.
source_boundaries.authority: Host finite source relation only, native_accepted false. Symbolic checking is separately owned. Shared FOL-machine request bytes can be decoded but no native encoding/acceptance or universal palette activation occurs here.

resources.owner: Root alone dispatches one separately reviewed bounded phase through shared_symbolic_search_outer_v1.py. Root activation must bind exact plan bytes; this freeze creates no activation.
resources.enforcement: Task-owned fail-closed sampled own-child /bin/ps RSS/time watchdog, worker SIGALRM, supervisor SIGALRM/SIGTERM kill-and-reap cleanup, retrospective kernel peak gate. No OS soft limit claim.
resources.outer: Includes verification, worker/supervisor execution, serialization and reap; outer own final receipt write excluded explicitly. Cleanup overshoot retained as unknown and charged.
resources.peak: supervisor own + fresh child kernel peak; outer own + max(outer children kernel peak, supervisor conservative combined peak), avoiding inherited child double counting.
resources.failure: Metadata failure or missing sample kills/reaps child and returns unknown. No retry or revised budget without a preserved source/input successor and review.

independent_next_gate.owner: external_prover_control authors separate source/plan; root alone dispatches after terminal producer
independent_next_gate.domains: Reconstruct complete primitive legal keys/counts at every trace state, validate scheduler decisions, chosen full permutations, every t/m change, exact rollback/refcounts/exclusions and all used primitive inference commands.
independent_next_gate.exhaustion: Every recorded excluded child must have full reconstructed finite failure/exhaustion, all alternatives covered, no resource-cutoff descendant. Unknown restores parent without excluding it.
independent_next_gate.fixed_order: Recompute exact generic AST/readiness/novelty tiers and both key stream hashes; no target-specific proof oracle.
independent_next_gate.certificate: Check original theory/hypotheses/target, strict-prior ordered references, full point identity/preimage/placement and every primitive inference; decode the exact flat request independently.
independent_next_gate.adversaries: Changed omitted legal candidate/singleton/dead label, false exhausted-child exclusion, rollback/reference count, remote zero/absence, ordered port multiplicity, decorated identity, native authority label, altered formula/theory/target, changed or dropped command/reference, stale body/source binding.

outcome_labels.finite_exact_point_tiling: Complete finite point certificate only, pending independent symbolic proof and whole trace audit.
outcome_labels.exhausted_finite_marked_subtree: If root returns exhausted, only the unchanged complete 24-row marked finite language was exhausted; no mathematical unprovability claim.
outcome_labels.unknown_search_budget: Attempt/time limit and exact root restoration; no unknown-child exclusions.
outcome_labels.unknown_trace_budget: Exact root restoration; truncated trace cannot certify finite exhaustion.
outcome_labels.owner_resource_unknown: Preserve partial raw outputs/receipts; no whole acceptance or automatic retry.

costs.source_authoring: Unmeasured; no cross-process monotonic subtraction or CPU-effort estimate.
costs.prior_preparation: All source native admissions (including original 546.8-second bill), all failed resource/serialization/loading attempts, finite transport and full primitive/lifecycle audits remain exact pinned dependencies, not free or newly native-admitted.
costs.cold_lane_setup: Each lane independently reloads exact model and validates all 171 families; separate setup, engine import and source verification timers are exported.
costs.search_subphases: Record fixed features/sort/permutation, complete domain ordering/hashing, graph/lifecycle counters, primitive step/resync, trace snapshots, exclusions and rollback timings. Overlapping subphase timers must not be summed as disjoint wall costs.
costs.total: Whole owner time includes cold preparation, all search work, decoder, serialization and supervisor costs. Separate independent audit and any later native query/replay are additional costs.
costs.inference_scope: One observation per order, no significance claim, new RL training or general speed comparison.

later_shared_native_gate.eligibility: Only the first independently accepted newly discovered certificate in predeclared base-then-fixed observation order; if none, preserve search unknowns and issue no native query.
later_shared_native_gate.resource_scope: Predeclare all native band capacities and exact encoded bytes after independent deterministic capacity estimate. The larger blank heap is an external resource boundary, not palette change. If estimate exceeds262144 or native run is unknown, stop; no automatic resize, shortened certificate or changed theory.
later_shared_native_gate.independent_full_replay: Separate predeclared owner180s/512MiB, exact fixed/free/input/output bytes and native-step/lowering fingerprints.
later_shared_native_gate.claim: Fresh shared-checker native acceptance of this certificate, not direct mathematical proof search on264143617200-square palette.
later_shared_native_gate.label: No native gate implementation or request execution in this source phase; any later exact request/band/lifetime source plan requires fresh root review.

read_scope: Compact family reader may physically decode example bytes before discarding them; no authored word is an ordering hint, proposal or mathematical acceptance authority.
